description: Research Meta ads with the harshmaur/facebook-ads-library-scraper Apify Actor: every ad a brand runs on Facebook, Instagram, Messenger and Audience Network, or every ad that matches a keyword in one country, as rows with ad copy, headline, call to action, landing page, image and video URLs, start and end dates, days live, a long-running flag, platforms, and the reach, spend and audience data Meta discloses for EU, UK and political ads. Use when the user says "show me Nike's Facebook ads", "what ads is this advertiser running", "find long-running ads for protein powder", "build an ad swipe file", "Meta Ad Library export", "advertiser ad research", "how long has this ad been live", "political ad spend on Facebook", or asks for Facebook or Instagram ads as JSON or CSV. No Facebook login, Meta API token or app review is needed. Out of scope: creating or managing ads, the user's own ad account metrics, and TikTok or Google ads.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
